pixel_review_observations: Full board and enlarged paw-detail pixels inspected. Compact natural four-limbed mammal, two rounded ears, short tail, charcoal coat and rust cheeks remain coherent across opposite profiles and turnarounds.
Forepaw close-up visibly separates five digits including a short medial grasping digit; hind sole visibly separates five toes.
Eating panel depicts organic food. Metal appears as a loose strip handled at nest, separate from the animal body and mouth.
Inactive scrap-bay nest, ledge scramble and short wall-cling are represented; no robot chassis, piston limbs or artificial armor are visible.
unresolved_qa: Fine digit topology is clearest in close-ups. Small standing, ventral, feeding and grasp poses do not allow all five digits to be independently verified.
Only near-leg profile identifiers are visible; full hidden-limb mapping remains incomplete.
Grasp versus locomotion pad deformation and wall-contact plausibility require rig/art review.
Gap-jump motion is not explicitly shown; the behavior row covers scramble, cling and nesting instead.
Style is more detailed semi-realistic fur than strongly low-poly faceting; simplify during approved art development if required.
